selection.rule: Include every record in the local demo source that has a matching cache, language=py, non-empty repo/base_commit/problem_statement/test_patch/gold patch, Python major.minor, install exactly `pip install -e .` or `pip install -e .[dev]`, pre_install limited to no commands or `apt-get update` + `apt-get install -y gcc`, and at least one FAIL_TO_PASS or PASS_TO_PASS target.

controlPolicy.invalidControlHandling: Never silently drop a frozen task. Mark INVALID_CONTROL with evidence if environment/gold control fails.
controlPolicy.goldPatchExposure: Gold solution is authority-only and never serialized into agent task input.
controlPolicy.hiddenTestExposure: Hidden test patch is injected only after agent exit.
